available.quote: Any person who shall present to the board a certified copy or certificate of registration or license which was issued to him after examination by a board of registration in optometry in any other state, where the requirements for registration are in the opinion of the board equivalent to those of this commonwealth, may be registered and given a certificate of registration in this commonwealth without a written examination

requirements.value: Applicant must present a certified copy of out-of-state registration/license; the other state's requirements must be equivalent in the board's opinion; the other state must accord a like privilege to MA holders; the applicant must not have previously failed the MA examination; must have been engaged in reputable practice continuously for at least 3 years immediately preceding application; and must intend to reside and practice in MA.
requirements.quote: provided, that such state accords a like privilege to holders of certificates of registration issued in this commonwealth, and that the applicant has not previously failed to pass the examination required in this commonwealth, and that he has been engaged in the reputable practice of optometry continuously for not less than three years immediately preceding his application, and that he intends to reside and practice optometry in this commonwealth

drug_authority.value: Registered optometrists may use topical diagnostic pharmaceutical agents (Section 66A); certified optometrists may use and prescribe topical therapeutic pharmaceutical agents in schedule VI (Section 66B); optometrists certified under Section 68C may use and prescribe topical and oral therapeutic pharmaceutical agents in schedules III, IV, V and VI, including for glaucoma treatment, but may not prescribe opioids, agents for systemic disease, or agents administered by injection.
